purpose: Versioned extension of the single Stödassistenten demand/friction regression map. This mapping stores product-learning memory only; it does not prove eligibility or factual truth.

mappings.product_miss: The product had dental and work/sickness coverage but no structured truth or regression for a user whose tooth injury arose at work or on the commute, creating a risk of conflating an incident report, Försäkringskassan cost reimbursement, ordinary dental support and possible Afa/collective-agreement compensation.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Create one review-gated Försäkringskassan dental-cost support record and lock the cross-route boundaries in Scenario Lab: work/commute connection and treatment necessity matter, reference price means full clinic price is not guaranteed, incident reporting is not benefit approval, and Afa/collective-agreement coverage remains a separate assessment.
